title: MLOPS↔BIZ-001: Model Deployment/Retraining Cost vs Business Case + Update Cadence
description: The MLOps Engineer provides cloud-infrastructure cost estimates for the MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) pipeline at target fleet scale, model-deployment and retraining operational-cost projections, and infrastructure-scaling assumptions for financial-model inputs; the Business Consultant provides the fleet-scale deployment requirements that determine MLOps infrastructure investment, the business case for model-retraining (update) cadence (data-freshness value vs. cloud-compute cost), and the operational-cost budget constraints for cloud-based MLOps pipelines. Grounded in MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.11. ASYMMETRY: BUSINESS_CONSULTANT_SKILL §6 has no MLOps subsection, so this contract is documented one-sided from the MLOps card; the §6.11 Provides/Requires pair documents both directions, so reciprocity is reconstructed from the single grounded side — this is grounded, NOT a DERIVED/invented contract. Model-update cadence informs but does not set OTA strategy; binding OTA cadence/governance lives in the MLOPS→DEVOPS→FW→BACK OTA chain (ADR-gated).

mlops_cost_package.description: MLOPS→BIZ: pipeline infra cost at fleet scale, deployment/retraining OpEx, scaling assumptions.

business_mlops_inputs.description: BIZ→MLOPS: fleet-scale deployment requirements, retraining/update-cadence business case, OpEx budget constraints.

retraining_cadence_business_case.description: Business case for model-retraining (customer-update) cadence: data-freshness value vs. cloud-compute cost.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine MLOps cost projection and update-cadence business-case exchange is agent-autonomous (scaling stage; quarterly operational cost review). A retraining cadence over the OpEx budget is surfaced as a freshness-vs-cost trade; binding model-update / OTA cadence is set in the OTA chain (ADR-gated), not here.
x-macp.source_status: ASYMMETRIC — grounded one-sided from MLOPS §6.11 (no BIZ §6 MLOps subsection); reciprocity reconstructed from the single documented side, not invented.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER + CALENDAR (at scaling stage; quarterly operational cost review)
confirm_conditions: pipeline infra cost, deployment/retraining OpEx, and budget constraints carry value, currency, and unit
fleet scale carries an explicit device-count unit
the retraining/update cadence carries an explicit unit (e.g., per quarter, days)
infra-scaling assumptions are stated where they feed the financial model
reject_conditions: a cost, fleet-scale, or cadence quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a retraining cadence over the OpEx budget presented as costed without the freshness-vs-cost trade (Honesty Over Polish §10.3)
a model-update / OTA cadence treated as set in this contract without the OTA-chain ADR (OTA governance stays in MLOPS→DEVOPS→FW→BACK)
counter_conditions: a fleet-scale requirement exceeds the validated ceiling (SCALE-1 50,000 devices) — request load/scaling validation before quoting infra cost
a proposed update cadence implies an OTA-strategy change — route the cadence change through the OTA chain (ADR) before committing the business case
